plans.title: The site, from an empty folder

events.words: Use reelplanning to plan: Build an interactive website about Bob Dylan. I want someone to be able to explore his life and music — the different eras, the albums, the songs and how they connect — in a way that's more engaging than reading a Wikipedia article, and it should work well on a phone. Start from scratch in this empty folder.
